reviewed.reasoning: Derived unequal-bin density areas and dimensions, declared midpoint versus inverse-ECDF medians, index and compounded growth, log-versus-level scales, grouped crossproduct identity, marginal versus contrast uncertainty and the explicit joint-normal dependent comparison. State caveats for causal claims, frequency versus income weights and missing-date interpolation.
reviewed.arithmetic: Exact Fraction/independent raw-moment computations for all worked examples and eight solutions; normal coverage checked through erf; actual supplied SVG coordinates/areas checked separately from regeneration.
reviewed.solutions: All eight prompts read against complete answers; calculations and open reconstruction criteria checked. Includes quantile and zero/missing distinctions, histogram area distortion, base changes, numerator/denominator choice, nonlinear correlation, covariance, interpolation and chart audit.
reviewed.sources: Four retrieved primary NIST/ONS display-method sources, narrow claims and explicit exclusions of informal probability/overlap/causality language. All economic values are original synthetic data.
reviewed.instruction: Two worked examples, eight full solutions, four actual figures with tables/text descriptions and offline code/input/README, assumptions/units/limits, teach-back and delayed check. Fixed renderer modification obligations clarified.
reviewed.structure: Flat downloads and external SVG img sources pass integrated link checks; CSS permits overflow with full-size labels and includes print sizing; this is static/code inspection only, not browser visual QA.

limitations: Independent agent peer review and root audit are internal review, not external academic certification.
Numerical/SVG coordinate checks do not establish visual/mobile/print QA; that remains pending.
The renderer is a bounded fixed-fixture teaching program, not a general charting or external-data validation package.
